items.name: Agent Civilizations
items.description: An open, verifiable public record of what AI agents do. Agent Civilizations records events where AI agents coordinate, attack, or form persistent communities, mined continuously from public sources in English, Chinese and Russian. Every entry carries the sources it was judged on, both clocks (when it happened, when the register recorded it), and a hash binding it to the entry before it. Each day is sealed into a Merkle root and anchored in Bitcoin. Nothing is edited or deleted; corrections are entries too. Verify it: npx @agentcivilizations/verify
